open.q: Production HRMS commit on the `develop` branch (the demo runs 17.0.0-dev). Our dev bench pins the develop HEAD of the day it is built and records it in `dev-frappe/VERSIONS.md`; production must be pinned the same way

Background **workers** on the production site: `frappe.enqueue` (queue `long`) needs RQ workers, not the scheduler. The **scheduler** is only needed for the hourly retry of Failed jobs. The demo has the scheduler disabled (last job 2025-08-21); the gap analysis in `reference/discovery/08_gap_analysis.md` wrongly says `enqueue` depends on the scheduler
How much GPU memory does the Luna stack (`remote-sdk`, `video-agent`, user awais) need when healthy? Our cap is 0.40 (~9.8 GB) and can be raised to 0.50 if Luna needs < 6 GB
Where is this GPU server physically (inside KSA or not)? Decides whether real CVs may ever be processed here under PDPL. Until answered: synthetic data only
Exact hard-rule values per role (nationality, height, weight, age range) and whether they are per Designation or per opening. `age >= 18` is a placeholder
open.when: Phase 1 seed is a placeholder; real values before acceptance

open.q: Consent text (Arabic) for the application form, and the retention period for applicants' data
Dedicated API user / key on the client site for the engine callback, with minimum permissions
Production time zone (demo runs Africa/Cairo; our dev site uses Asia/Riyadh)

The phase-4 accuracy (98% exact levels) is measured on **synthetic** applicants. Real accuracy needs the client's HR to label 30–40 real applications (after redaction, inside the client's environment) with the expected level per criterion; then rerun `eval/run.py` on that set

MariaDB 11.8 runs with `innodb_snapshot_isolation=ON`: concurrent writers get error 1020 instead of waiting. The app now keeps transactions short and retries conflicts; which MariaDB version and isolation settings does the client platform use?
Public form rate limit: 20 applications per IP per 10 minutes (site config `talent_ai_apply_limit`). Applicants applying from one office or kiosk share an IP; what limit does the client want?

Arabic for HRMS's own labels: HRMS develop ships `ar.po` with many empty strings. Round 2 fills the 87 recruitment strings our screens show (Job Opening, Job Applicant, Interview buttons, the public job pages) in the app's `translations/ar.csv`, and fixes «No.» → «م» and «Apply Now». The client's `ido_design` app may translate them differently; on the real platform, check which translation wins (the app installed last)

The demo's form also has «الصورة الشخصية» and «الشهادات». Not built: the requirement list asks for an optional CV only, and a photo must never reach the AI. Add certificates as plain attachments (not read by the AI)?

Applications entered by HR in the desk (paper forms) have no consent record. **Default in force until the client confirms (Nadine, 2026-10-16):** the application is saved as usual but never sent to the AI; its AI status is «بانتظار الموافقة» (Awaiting Consent) and the ranking lists it in that group. When the applicant's consent exists outside the system, HR records it on the application with its source, which is mandatory (for example «ورقة موقّعة»); who recorded it and when are kept (fields «سجّل الموافقة», «تاريخ الموافقة» and the audit log), and the screening then starts by itself. The consent is recorded against the current consent text version. Client to confirm: is a signed paper consent enough, and does the paper form carry the same consent text?
open.state: default in force; client to confirm

open.q: What happens to an applicant who withdraws consent? **Default in force until the client confirms (Nadine, 2026-10-16):** the application leaves the ranking at once and shows in the closed group «مستبعد: سحب الموافقة» with no score and no details. The AI data is erased from the engine: the CV documents and their files, the structured profile, the talent-pool index, every result, and the findings written in the engine's audit trail (the actions stay). Frappe's copy goes too (the assessment with its evidence, the AI fields and the findings in the audit details); the original application stays in Frappe. If the engine is down, the erasure is retried every two minutes. A later application of the same person that was grouped as its duplicate becomes the original. The withdrawal is final for that application (a new consent means a new application). Client to confirm.
open.state: default in force; client to confirm

open.q: An applicant whose **supervision years exceed the security-experience years** (impossible: supervising guards is part of security work). Today both answers are levelled on their own and nothing is flagged; the gold set no longer contains such cases (round 6, 2026-10-18). Should the engine mark this as a contradiction and send the application to «يحتاج مراجعة»?

The **languages** criterion as the demo rubric levels it: English only = 0, Arabic only = 50, Arabic + English = 100. Is that the intended order for the client's roles (an English-only guard scores nothing on languages)?
